_comment: Bridge monitor (.github/workflows/bridge-monitor.yml, zetaphy bridge monitor --monitor-config). Public values only. Empty bridgeGuard/bridgeAirlock fall back to zetaphy-launch/state/77390.json; with neither, the monitor does nothing. rpc: the public https RPC (or the repository variable ZETAPHY_RPC). startBlock: the block deploy-bridge ran at (first scan). sourceRpc + lockbox: optional, to see deposits no lane attested.
